title: International Foundation Diploma In Law (Level 3)
description: Enhance your legal and leadership abilities with the Endorsed Diploma in Law (Level 3).
university: The Global School of Skills (GSS) and OTHM UK
longDescription: A Law course provides a comprehensive understanding of Introduction to Law and Practice,Principles of Contract Law,Principles of Criminal Law,Introduction to Employment Law,Aspects of Tort Law and Academic and Research Skills for Law legal principles, systems, and practices. It covers key areas such as constitutional law, contract law, criminal law, and human rights. Students develop critical thinking, problem-solving, and analytical skills necessary for legal practice and navigating complex legal issues. After the successful completion of the program, you will earn a UK 120 credit hours certification awarded by GSS partners.
courseDetails: The Endorsed Diploma in a Law course offers in-depth knowledge of legal frameworks, focusing on areas such as Introduction to Law and Practice, Principles of Contract Law,Principles of Criminal Law, Introduction to Employment Law, Aspects of Tort Law and Academic and Research Skills for Law. It equips students with skills in legal research, analysis, and problem-solving. The course prepares graduates for careers in law, policy, or further academic pursuits in legal studies.
courseDetailParagraphs: The Endorsed Diploma in a Law course offers in-depth knowledge of legal frameworks, focusing on areas such as Introduction to Law and Practice, Principles of Contract Law,Principles of Criminal Law, Introduction to Employment Law, Aspects of Tort Law and Academic and Research Skills for Law. It equips students with skills in legal research, analysis, and problem-solving. The course prepares graduates for careers in law, policy, or further academic pursuits in legal studies.
entry: Endorsed Diploma In Law (Level-3), learners must possess:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Results can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Results. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
* Learner must be 18 years and older at the start of the Course.
Mature Learners (21 years and older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership or management roles. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
progression: Upon completing the Endorsed Diploma In Law (Level-3) students become eligible to pursue advanced studies, including admission into a master's degree. This qualification opens doors to various programs, allowing students to specialize further in areas such as business administration, finance, or marketing.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors. Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak to our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
gettingStartedIntro: Complete the application, document review, offer, payment and enrolment steps through the learner portal.
certificateDetails: You will receive a degree from GSS Partner Universities.
